title: Red Wine Braised Beef Cheeks
steps: Pat cheeks dry and season.
Brown in batches; set aside.
Sauté mirepoix; add tomato paste and brown.
Deglaze with wine; reduce by half.
Add stock and thyme; return cheeks and braise at 150 C until tender.
Rest and reduce sauce to glaze.
tips: Skim fat; finish with a knob of butter for shine.

title: Slow Braised Oxtail Stew
steps: Brown oxtail deeply.
Sweat aromatics; deglaze and add liquids.
Braise at 150 C until gelatinous and soft.
Skim fat and adjust seasoning.
tips: Tastes better next day; reheat gently.

title: Osso Buco alla Milanese
steps: Tie and season shanks; dredge lightly.
Brown shanks; sauté vegetables.
Deglaze with wine; add stock and braise until tender.
Serve topped with gremolata.
tips: Keep marrow intact by gentle handling.

title: Butter-Basted Ribeye
steps: Preheat pan until smoking; sear 2.5 min per side.
Add butter, garlic, thyme; baste.
Rest and slice; target 54–57 C internal.
tips: Dry the steak very well for crust.

title: Quick Beef Stir-fry
steps: Marinate briefly; pat dry.
Stir-fry over very high heat under 2–3 minutes total.
Toss with vegetables just to combine.
tips: Cook in batches; do not steam the meat.

title: Classic Bolognese
steps: Brown mince well.
Add soffritto; cook until sweet.
Add liquids and simmer gently until rich.

title: Wagyu Smash Burgers
steps: Form loose balls; smash onto hot griddle.
Sear about 4 minutes total; season and serve.
tips: Do not add oil; the fat renders abundantly.

title: Roasted Marrow Bones
steps: Season bones; roast at 220 C about 20 minutes.
Serve with parsley salad and toast.
tips: Do not overcook; marrow should just quiver.

title: Pho Broth with Brisket Bones
steps: Blanch bones; rinse.
Simmer gently with aromatics for 6 hours.
Season with fish sauce and serve.

title: Lengua Tacos
steps: Pressure cook tongue until tender; natural release.
Peel while warm; dice and sear.
Serve on tortillas with toppings.
